case: A skill's declared tool grant is recorded without being inert, so frontmatter grants tools for the turn that loads it.
why: 05 section 8's rule that a prose package cannot install, contact, spend or execute by being loaded is FALSE of the named runtime -- R2 F-08 and R6 F7 -- which is why the rule was made structural. With the inertness comparison gone, the field records an effect rather than requiring it to be none, and the skill-grant path is open again. Coverage note: F6C-16 measured 14 of 30 guards exercised by a paired adverse and benign fixture, and `guard.skill.declared_grant_inert` was one of the sixteen without one -- a guard registered with no adverse fixture is a guard nobody has seen fail.
